findings.text: EPS $2.68 against $2.49 expected (+7.6%); revenue $115.84B against $109.28B expected (+6.0%). Results above estimates, reported 2026-11-17.

Jensen Huang is no longer CEO. Colette Kress is interim CEO and CFO, and the earnings release says the company is in a leadership transition and searching for a new chief executive officer, so no permanent successor is named.

The release says the board's independent committee investigation is ongoing, and a securities class action on behalf of purchasers from 2024-12-19 to 2026-11-12 was announced by Rosen on 2026-11-18. The Rosen item is a law firm notice and is not counted as new litigation.

Q4 FY2027 outlook: revenue of $130.0 billion plus or minus 3%, with no Data Center compute revenue from China assumed; GAAP and non-GAAP gross margin of 71.0% to 72.0%; and operating expenses of about $11.0 billion GAAP and $10.7 billion non-GAAP. No prior guidance for this quarter is in the evidence, so this is context.
NVIDIA announced an agreement to acquire Hugging Face in the earnings release.

Capital return: the board raised the buyback authorization by $150 billion in September 2026, leaving about $227.3 billion remaining. Q3 returns were $28.1 billion. The next quarterly dividend is $0.25, with ex-dividend date 2026-12-02 and payment on 2026-12-23.
Supply and capacity commitments rose to $279 billion as of July 26, 2026, from $119 billion the prior quarter. Guarantees for an Ohio campus are capped at $105 billion.
The stock closed 3.3% lower over the window from the close before the 2026-11-17 report to the close two days after it.
As of 2026-11-18, the Technology sector fund XLK changed -11.7% over 1 month, -10.5% over 3 months and +15.5% over 12 months, while SPY changed -5.1%, -4.2% and +9.7% over the same periods.
Over the same periods to 2026-11-18, NVDA changed -30.3% over 1 month, -30.4% over 3 months and -19.1% over 12 months.
As of 2026-11-18, VIX was 24.6, against a one-year median of 17.2 and a one-year range of 13.5 to 31.0. Its near-term level sits above its three-month level (inverted term structure).

Scheduled releases in the near term are Gross Domestic Product and Personal Income and Outlays on 2026-11-25, Employment Situation on 2026-12-04, and Consumer Price Index on 2026-12-10. The next FOMC decision is on 2026-12-09.
Data releases are scheduled only through 2026-12-23, and no release after that date is yet scheduled. The FOMC calendar runs to 2027-01-27 for the next decision after 2026-12-09.
